content:
**Chem Resistant** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*. 

It is exclusive to human players and cannot be equipped by ghoul players.

Reduces chance of addiction to chems.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | You gain complete immunity to chem addiction. | 00065E0C | 
| ★ | 1 | You're half as likely to get addicted when consuming Chems. | 0004A0D5 | 

Chem Fiend - perk that increases chems duration.
